Method of Attack: Compromised the app's update mechanism to deliver malware in a supply-chain attack
Impacted Systems: Passwordstate, an on-premises password management solution
Attack Vector: The initial compromise pointed the In-Place Upgrade functionality to a CDN network not controlled by Click Studios
Indicators of Compromise: Computer Name, User Name, Domain Name, Current Process Name, Current Process Id, All running Processes name and ID, All running services name, display name and status, Passwordstate instance’s Proxy Server Address, Username and Password, and The following fields in Passwordstate instance’s password table: Title, UserName, Description, GenericField1, GenericField2, GenericField3, Notes, URL, Password
